name: Enumerate the ensemble
note: Method step 1. Context in, misfit list out. Alexander's first move is negative definition: you cannot state what makes a form fit, only what would make it fail. The agent's whole job here is to externalize the failure modes as a finite, falsifiable set — the ensemble is data from this point on, not a feeling.

cells.prompt: Enumerate the misfit variables of this design problem — the finite set of binary requirements whose activation would be a failure of fit between form and context. Emit {"misfits": [{"id": "m1", "text": "one falsifiable failure statement"}, ...]}. 6 to 12 misfits. No positives, only failure modes.
